rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for sewing thread and for a thin filament or strand.

example.english: This thread is very fine and just right for sewing clothes.
example.traditional: 呢卷線好幼，拎嚟縫衫啱啱好。

rows.note: Use this for the sequence or direction of someone’s reasoning or ideas.

example.english: Your explanation is so clear that I can finally follow your thread of thought.
example.traditional: 你講解得好清楚，我終於跟到你嘅思路。

rows.note: Use this for an online series of posts and replies about one topic.
